title: FOCAL couples interpretable ML to regulatory networks and finds NFATC2-IRF8 interplay
summary: FOCAL couples state-specific and dynamic gene regulatory networks with outcome-supervised latent factors learned by interpretable machine learning to prioritize regulatory subnetworks. In B and T cells it prioritized subnetworks underlying established states and transient episodes preceding them. It uncovered an NFATC2-IRF8 interplay in activated B cells, validated by in vitro and in vivo genetic perturbations, where the two factors restrain plasmablast differentiation and promote germinal center fate. Preprint; mouse and cell systems.
ai_technology: FOCAL: interpretable latent-factor machine learning coupled to gene regulatory networks
